gold: Community-acquired methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (CA-MRSA) sepsis with septic vasculopathy

selector.rationale: Purpura Fulminans best explains the purpuric retiform patches, diffuse papules, and rapid deterioration, with the highest score and most supporting evidence

rejected.label: Disseminated Intravascular Coagulation (DIC)
rejected.why: while DIC is a possible complication, it does not fully explain the specific skin findings and purpuric retiform patches

rejected.label: Neisseria meningitidis infection
rejected.why: less specific than Neisseria meningitidis sepsis and does not fully capture the severity of the presentation

rejected.label: Staphylococcal sepsis
rejected.why: Gram-positive cocci in vessels suggest a possible staphylococcal infection, but the clinical presentation and score favor Purpura Fulminans
